text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yikes, this is bad! I exceeded my weight class, but my race is right around the corner! Me too! Ugh, I hate having to be all careful about my weight and condition!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha. Sorry, but I couldn't help but I overhear your discussion and woes. Allow me to open your eyes to some new possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: If you don't like the work required to lose weight, then you just have to think of a more entertaining way to do it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: First off, let me hear your soul sing! C'mon, feel the rhythm!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This place is famous for its fireworks show! Let's search for an advantageous spot to watch it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Oh! How about the top of a waterslide? It looks like we'll have to climb a ton of stairs to get up there, but let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wheeew… That sure was a great detox session at the spa! Okay, up on our schedule is…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A dance party! Let's make the most of this moment! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, incredible! Show me more of what you're capable of!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeking the Pearl keeps up the pace and in no time finds herself back in top racing form and physique.
